#!/bin/sh
cscli -c "$CFG" machines add -a --force
cscli_cfg machines add -a --force
cscli_hub 60 hub update
cscli version
command -v cscli >/dev/null
run_interruptible timeout 60 cscli -c "$CFG" hub upgrade
cscli -c "$CFG" \
    bouncers list
x=$(cscli -c "$CFG" parsers list)
#!/bin/sh
if command -v cscli >/dev/null; then
cscli -c "$CFG" machines list
sudo -E cscli -c "$CFG" machines list
env CHARON_X=1 cscli -c "$CFG" hub update
echo sudo cscli machines list
echo ok && echo cscli machines list
sudo cscli_cfg machines list
